title: distributed callpath telemetry adapter for serverless invocations
creator: Marcus Liu
description: Goal: add a lightweight, privacy-conscious callpath telemetry adapter that instruments serverless-style invocations (short-lived runtimes and cold starts) to improve per-invocation latency/error visibility without increasing request payloads or inducing production tail latency. This ticket covers: (1) SDK-level hooking for Node and Python to capture a compact provenance hash and invocation attributes, (2) middleware for edge/proxy to forward the compact provenance header and sampling hint, and (3) Console/metrics plumbing to show per-route cold-start and tail-latency breakdowns.
non_goals: This ticket will not implement full distributed diagnostic baggage propagation (large arbitrary key/value baggage) nor change existing trace ids. It also will not onboard all legacy language SDKs — initial rollout is Node/Python only.
approach: 1) Compute a compact provenance hash on invocation: H = hmac_sha256(K_secret, service_name||route||short-trace-id||cold_start_flag) and base64-url encode first 10 bytes. 2) Expose SDK hook api: rw.instruments.addInvocationHook(fn) that can augment request context and emit a small header X-RW-PROV (<12B payload typical) and X-RW-SAMPLE hint. 3) Edge middleware reads those headers and emits local spans with an attribute 'prov.hash' and 'prov.coldstart'. 4) Service runtime will log structured fields (prov.hash, route, coldstart, handler_ms) to our log pipeline with a well-known schema for downstream aggregation. 5) Console will join logs+traces by prov.hash and present per-prov histograms and error rates. 6) Implement opt-out via env var REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_PROV=off and rotate secret via KMS TTL.
tradeoffs: - Using a small provenance hash sacrifices full reconstructability for privacy and payload size guarantees. - We avoid adding large baggage to traces to keep carrier sizes small for serverless cold starts. - A secret HMAC requires key rotation handling; we will use KMS-backed ephemeral keys to limit blast radius. - This design favors high-cardinality grouping (prov.hash) over full key-value propagation, which may complicate some ad-hoc debugging use-cases.
acceptance_criteria: - Node and Python SDKs include addInvocationHook and automatically set X-RW-PROV and X-RW-SAMPLE on instrumented requests if enabled. - End-to-end integration test demonstrates <150 microsecond added latency on average for SDK hook in microbench harness and <1% throughput regression at 95th percentile. - Edge middleware emits spans with 'prov.hash' attribute and logs include structured fields. - Console dashboard shows per-route cold-start, median/95/99 latency splits and error-rate by prov.hash for a synthetic canary traffic. - Feature flagging present and can be toggled from Console for a single customer or route. - PRs merged in SDK repos and edge middleware repo with tests and doc pages linked.
comments: 2026-03-02 Marcus Liu: Kickoff — scoped Node/Python SDK hooks, edge middleware, Console join. Action items: Anika to draft SDK API, Rafael to prototype edge middleware header passthrough, SRE to run perf harness.

2026-03-03 Anika Patel: API sketch uploaded to design doc. Chose header names X-RW-PROV and X-RW-SAMPLE. Prototype shows 90us median overhead in synthetic loop (Node). Added opt-out env var and sampling rate control.

2026-03-04 Rafael Gomez (review): Security note — provenance hash must not be reversible; recommend using HKDF with per-tenant salt and KMS-managed root key. Also flagged key-rotation plan. Marked security_review_required = true.

2026-03-05 Design review (PM: Leila O'Connor): Console UX needs ability to group by prov.hash and also .../route to surface cold-start hotspots. Suggest adding 'prov.coldstart' tag to logs for quick filtering.

2026-03-06 SRE perf run: Node SDK hook added 118us median, 240us p95 on microbench with 1k qps; Python ~140us median. Memory increase minimal (~0.4 MB). Action: optimize HMAC truncation codepath and consider a C-extension for Python hot path if needed.
2026-03-07 Anika: Changed HMAC to use truncated Blake2b for faster performance on AMD64 per perf notes. Uploaded updated PR to sdk-node and sdk-python.

2026-03-08 QA: End-to-end canary with synthetic cold-starts (10% traffic) shows prov hashes group cold-start spikes successfully in Grafana panel. Noted one false-negative when proxy strips unknown headers — added middleware fallback to inject prov if missing and origin has trace id.

2026-03-09 PR review (Infra): Edge middleware PR revised to avoid header caching on 5xx responses; added unit tests and integration tests against smoke harness. Linking PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/infra-edge/pull/2045
2026-03-10 Anika: Merging SDK PRs after addressing CI flakiness and adding docs. Next: coordinate canary rollout, update Console dashboard, and schedule security review for KMS key rotation flow.
